T: Why so serious. It's only dinner.
D: Batman, Gordon and the new district attorney take on a criminal mastermind who wants Gotham in chaos.
P: Serve the mains when Bruce drags his date over to join Rachel and Harvey's dinner table.
S: Seared beef fillet on crostini with horseradish cream, smoked salmon blinis with crème fraîche and chives, served on black trays.
Batman's trip to Hong Kong to grab Lau
Char siu pork belly cubes roasted with honey, hoisin and five-spice, on toothpicks with pickled cucumber.
the playing card the Joker leaves behind
Cheese crackers cut into card-sized rectangles, a red paprika suit stencilled on each, baked crisp, with a whipped ricotta dip.
M: Bruce makes the restaurant push two tables together
Pan-roasted salmon on crushed potatoes with a lemon and caper butter, and a peppery rocket salad, the sort of plate a fancy Gotham restaurant sends out.
late nights at the police station
Beef and pork meatloaf glazed with tomato and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour, sliced thick with mash and gravy.
W: Crisp pastry with a smooth, sharp lemon cream, finished with icing sugar. Blind bake a 23cm sweet shortcrust case at 180C for 20 minutes.

s.how: Sear a 300g eye fillet to rare, rest and slice thin. Toast baguette slices and top with the beef and horseradish cream. Top 12 blinis with crème fraîche, 100g smoked salmon and chives. Serve on black trays.

s.note: Batman's trip to Hong Kong to grab Lau
s.how: Cut 800g pork belly into cubes and toss with 3 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp five spice. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, glazing twice. Quick-pickle a sliced cucumber in rice vinegar. Serve on toothpicks.

m.note: Bruce makes the restaurant push two tables together
m.how: Roast 4 salmon fillets skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes. Crush 800g boiled potatoes with butter. Melt 60g butter with lemon juice and 1 tbsp capers and spoon over. Serve with a peppery rocket salad.

w.how: Blind bake a 23cm sweet shortcrust case at 180C for 20 minutes. Whisk 4 eggs, 150g sugar, 150ml lemon juice, lemon zest and 150ml cream, pour in and bake at 150C for 30 minutes until just set. Chill and dust with icing sugar.

d.how: Pour 30ml single malt Scotch neat into each of four tumblers. Put a jug of water on the side. Some men just want to watch the world burn, the rest want a quiet drink.
